About Me

The story so far

I'm a Computer Engineering student with hands-on experience in WordPress, Shopify, and full-stack web development. My work spans building e-commerce solutions, responsive websites, and real-world web applications during internships and academic projects.

What started as curiosity about how websites work has grown into practical experience — customizing live company websites, building AI-powered data tools, and working across the frontend and backend. I'm eager to keep learning new technologies and take on more meaningful, industry-facing projects.
